subject: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!
parts:
Dear All,

MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 is released in Tool Store of Skyline. 

The updates are the same as MSstats.daily 2.1.6 and also the minor bugs for external tool itself were fixed.
You can update from Tool Store of Skyline, or use 'update' option under Tool, which will come up if you have v2.1.5 in your computer.

If you had any difficulty, please let us know.
Thank you.

Sincerely yours,

Meena

messages.author: 76268d6fdc0699b7
messages.subject: Re: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!
parts:
Dear Meena

sorry to bother you with an other installation issue but I've got some troubles with MSstats and skyline.

I try to install MSstats_2.1.6_external for skyline.

R 3.0.3 was succesfully installed.

I've got an error message after "SkylineProcessRunner": "unknown error installing packages. Output logged to the immediate window"
We can read on the immediate window: "The system cannot find the path specified."


I got the same issue with the MSstats-1_0.zip

How can I solve this problem?

thanks for your help

Sophie.

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!
parts:
Dear Sophie,

I'm sorry to hear this installation problem. First of all, I would like to ask you what language you use in your computer. So far, we have the issue in Korean setting of Window and have worked to fix it. If you used different language setting in your computer, have you ever tried to troubleshoot in 'Known issue' document? (msstats.org > installation > the link 'known issues and proposed solutions' ) Based on my experience, some computers had the same issue when antivirus program blocked to install some required packages. After you try and still have the problem, please let me know. I hope it will help.

Thank you,

Meena

messages.author: 76268d6fdc0699b7
messages.subject: Re: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!
parts:
Thanks for your quick answer.
I managed to install MSstats package by re-installing skyline as administrator.

Is there any way to run MSstats with the same peptide modified and non-modified? (such as methione oxided or not )?



Sophie

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!
parts:
Dear Sophie,

If a peptide is present in a modified and a non-modified form, you can include both forms into protein quantification if these forms have different identifies (i.e. the string of characters that defines the peptide ion is changed to reflect the modification). However you should be careful with this approach, because modifications can distort the quantitative profiles of a protein between runs, and introduce more interferences than benefit.

messages.author: 76268d6fdc0699b7
messages.subject: Re: MSstats external tool in Skyline v2.1.6 release!
parts:
thanks,
problem solved by changing the MSstat report setting in skyline.
the parameter should be "PeptideModifiedsequence" instead of "peptidesequence".

Sophie
